name: Regigigas
description: According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user tramples its target into the ground, dealing damage. This also lowers the target’s action speed.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a primeval power. This may also raise the user's offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head.

moves.name: Crush Grip
moves.description: The target is crushed with great force. The more HP the target has left, the greater this move's power.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power.
